title: USDC on Base - Fees, Speed & How to Use | USDC.org | USDC.org
excerpts: Base is an Ethereum Layer 2 network built by Coinbase. It launched in August 2023 and has quickly become one of the most popular chains for USDC. The core pitch is simple: Ethereum's security at a fraction of the cost. Transaction fees on Base are typically under a penny, and confirmations take about two seconds. For most everyday USDC use cases, Base is the best default. USDC on Base is issued natively by Circle rather than bridged from Ethereum.

title: Modern Treasury Adds USDC on Base, Expanding Stablecoin Support
excerpts: Modern Treasury today announced support for USDC on Base for business payments. Customers can now send and receive USDC on Base through the Modern Treasury payment operations platform.

title: How to Get USDC on Base | Get Digital Dollars on Base
excerpts: You can buy USDC on Base directly from supported exchanges and wallets. Circle issues native USDC on Base, redeemable 1:1 for US dollars.

title: USDC on the Base app | Coinbase Help
excerpts: Sending USDC between Coinbase accounts on Base does not incur network fees. This makes it ideal for payments. The Base app supports holding and sending USDC on the Base network.
